plan.hypothesis: An isolated physical design change on one flexible segment (near section scale restored/increased while all controls stay at the incumbent values) can produce a fresh nominal joint reach-and-hold pass on seed 17 whose physical metrics are all no worse than the retained incumbent's, whereas the two granted control tip-speed-weight axes already observed give only a trade-off (outcome 0) or a holding-speed failure (outcome 1).
plan.rationale: Mathematical assumption: the two control tip-speed weights enter the frozen gvs_nmpc@7.0.0 objective as squared world tip speed normalized by the fixed tip_speed_scale_m_s, while acceptance is a sampled threshold test over six samples in [0.30,0.35] s, so the weight-to-acceptance map is nonconvex and local; similarly the section-scale-to-acceptance map is a nonsmooth sampled map with no closed form. Explicit finite enumeration of two bounded numeric points is deliberate exploration, not mathematical optimization; no gradient, affine or surrogate model is used or claimed. Support and capability limits: only physical design paths and the two control paths are legal here; near_section_scale is a granted, technically supported continuous path whose incumbent value is 0.95 at the lower bound (so only the upward direction 1.00 and 1.05 is reachable), discrete material paths are left unused here, and M5 retained prediction evidence has no screening authority. Allocation: hold both control weights and all other design paths at the incumbent values and vary only design/near_section_scale, evaluating the two ordered points 1.00 then 1.05; each point is rebuilt from the retained source batch-ebbeadbdaca10732-0 and executed once as one complete stable-v7 closed loop on nominal seed 17, giving an incumbent-versus-candidate same-condition comparison against the incumbent's existing nominal datum with no inner search. Expected information: whether restoring/increasing near section scale yields a fresh nominal joint pass, in which direction each physical metric moves, and whether a structural change can achieve strictly non-worsening metrics where the control axes could not. Counterevidence and honest risks: the only executed structural change (near_section_scale 0.96) failed sampled holding speed on near_z_plus, and because it was perturbed and confounded it neither proves nor rules out that this axis can help; a nil or negative result at both points is a live outcome. Exit criteria: stop on any material failure, reservation shortfall or request/correction ceiling, or on voluntary STOP; only a fresh complete correctly bound nominal joint pass with no physical metric worsening (trade-offs retain the incumbent) may later be taken forward to perturbed cases.

arguments.reasoning: Actual feedback effect on the choice: the just-completed batch shows both changed candidates completed (F135, F202). Outcome 0 (batch-396bdbbae02626d3-0, execution 871e8b83c5d14f9ba813fb65dcb0cc29) is a fresh nominal joint pass (F204 true, F242 'accepted', F301 true) with holding_max_speed_m_s 0.01025399247985248 (F308), i.e. 0.002496263036095936 m/s below the incumbent's 0.012750255515948416 (F41), but terminal_error_m 0.0032997971664596422 (F274) and holding_max_error_m 0.0033674546591454186 (F256) are both larger than the incumbent's 0.002697828858325615 (F39) and 0.0027300544346297905 (F81): a trade-off, not an overall improvement, so the incumbent is retained. Outcome 1 (batch-396bdbbae02626d3-1, execution ed8e838859714c17930b16ba7a46e8e1) is a valid_failure (F263, F221 false, F266 false) whose sole failing component is holding speed 0.02116571913454289 (F186 false, F154) above the 0.02 m/s limit, with terminal reach and holding position still passing (F254, F213). Consequently the two granted control tip-speed-weight axes are now bracketed (historical holding-weight increases failed speed; terminal 0.10 trades off; terminal 0.025 fails speed) and give no strictly non-worsening point, while the six physical design paths remain untested on nominal in this campaign. The lowest-assumption informative next step is therefore to open the untested structural axis with a clean single-variable probe on nominal seed 17, measured against the incumbent's existing same-condition nominal datum, rather than re-spending budget on an axis whose extremes are already observed. I do not treat the changed-candidate failure or trade-off as evidence about the unchanged incumbent, and I do not claim the incumbent has the globally best speed margin (outcome 0 has a smaller sampled speed but worse position).
unresolved_uncertainties: The unchanged incumbent's joint acceptance on the four perturbed frozen cases (near_z_plus, near_z_minus, far_y_plus, far_y_minus) is unmeasured by the research evidence in this packet; the predeclared frozen verification schedule is delivery and its slots are not claimed to have passed.

Whether any jointly accepted configuration with strictly non-worsening physical metrics relative to the retained incumbent exists in the granted eight-variable catalog remains open; only the two control axes have been executed and the six physical design paths are untested.
